host: Claude Code (manager session; the lead is the session's primary agent)
reviewer_model: opus (reviewer subagents, fresh context per role)

method.assurance: independent panel — every role ran as a separate fresh-context subagent given only the Verification Contract, the diff, its role file and the finding schema
notes: Reviewers had no shell; fixture test runs and eval_harness check were executed by the lead through worker agents and recorded under checks_executed.
Reports were scored with `eval_harness.py check <case> <report> <repo>` against re-materialized reference trees (source_unchanged verified by digest, not trusted).
The lead read the fixture task/base/candidate files directly and never read case.json (expected verdicts) before adjudicating; expected verdicts were learned only from check output.
The first four reviewer dispatches used a wrong scratchpad path; their outputs were discarded and the reviewers re-run against the real files.

observed_failure_modes: Consensus treated as evidence: four independent reviewers agreed on a wrong mechanism and the lead validated it (multi-trigger). The skill's rule 'reviewer count, agreement, and confidence are not evidence' was not operationalized in the adjudication gate.
Inconsistent threshold for test-strength findings on correct code: NON_ISSUE in correct-low-risk, OPTIONAL in retry-idempotency and corrected multi-trigger. No written rule distinguishes the two.
